variables.prompt: a clean empty background that continues the surrounding scene

description: Masked inpainting and object removal with Z-Image Turbo (ZImageInpaintPipeline): white mask pixels are repainted from the prompt, the rest is kept. Uses the same Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo checkpoint as models/z-image, so a server that has one has the other, and fits a 24 GB card with offload where FLUX.1 Fill (templates/inpaint) needs a 54 GB download. To remove an object, prompt for what should replace it (the background), not for the object being removed.

vram_estimate.reason: reuses the models/z-image text-to-image calibration (#945): same transformer, text encoder and VAE with offload: model, so the resident weights match; the inpaint pass adds the encoded source image and mask latents, small beside the weights. Image size follows the input image, so the per-voxel term is only the batch count here. Calibrate on lem (#946)
